services.desc: Welcome to Fast Track Swimming in Cypress, TX - your destination for fun, fitness, and family-friendly activities. Our Cypress location offers expert swimming lessons for all ages and skill levels, taught by certified instructors in a state-of-the-art indoor facility. Whether you’re learning to swim for the first time or refining advanced techniques, we provide a safe and supportive environment. In addition to our swimming programs, we feature 2 air conditioned, top-quality Pickleball courts that can be used for half-court basketball, making Fast Track a hub for active lifestyles and community recreation. services.name: Swim Lessons
services.desc: WATER SAFETY CLASS/SEAHORSE: This class focuses on what to do when falling into the water for children 6 months to 2 years. Roll to float, float for a longer time waiting for someone to come and get them and/or finding the edge of the pool to climb out. If the child is coordinated enough the teacher will incorporate elementary backstroke and front crawl arms. STARFISH: 3 to 4 year olds are considered starfish, because it is designed to help children learn safety in the pool much like the seahorse class, but geared towards our older friends. blurb: We start at 6 months and up and pride ourselves in being one of the swim schools helping Texas fight drowning prevention with our water safety program. What sets us apart from other swim schools is our class sizes for beginners. We never put your child in a group class full of non swimmers. Years and years of teaching success has taught us that throwing children in a group class is unsafe and puts them at risk.
